name: Lunxiao (Claude) Li
title: Ph.D. Student in Computer Science, North Carolina State University
tagline: Ph.D. Student in Computer Science @ North Carolina State University
about: Hi, my name is Lunxiao Li and I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at North Carolina State University. I am interested in Large Language Model (LLM) related topics, with a focus on the applications of LLMs in Computer Science.

news.content: Started my graduate study at North Carolina State University, and joined CSC 422 (Automated Learning and Data Analysis) as a Teaching Assistant!

contactLead: Feel free to reach out about research, collaboration, or anything else — the best way to contact me is by email.
